snippet.title: Menes: The Chainbreaker - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
You're a soul-shard of an Archangel, you have wings and a living sword that gets stronger each time you parry. You are Menes. Defeat Gods and monsters, overcome hazards, uncover mysterious lore and explore surreal aesthetics.

Menes: The Chainbreaker out on all Xbox devices and Steam on 13th of November 2026

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2891970/Menes_The_Chainbreaker/
Follow for updates:  https://discord.gg/ywxtHzGb9K

A game by: Adrian Podaru
Funded by: Cristian Marin
Produced by: Denis Damian
Music by: https://www.youtube.com/@SilentStrikeMusic  
Voice by: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCx9yM4mvVjuId9_tCbpL9Qg
Sound design: Silent Strike & https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCZ-sdDoXGXr1eWOk_U7Q2MA
Cat paintings by: https://www.instagram.com/wannabe.artist.a/
Thumbnail art by: https://www.artstation.com/romansabrina/albums/15205159
